finalText:
**Build's clean.** Exit 0, 0 errors.

Two real bugs from the bump, both fixed:

1. [`src/core/options.js`](src/core/options.js) — bundler now hands options as `{ retryCount }`, not `{ retries }`. Was calling `.toFixed()` on `undefined`.
2. [`src/net/retryPolicy.js`](src/net/retryPolicy.js) — new config loader leaves unset flags `undefined` instead of `false`. Strict check threw on that. Now treats `undefined` as disabled.

Rest of the noise is just deprecation warnings from the bump, unrelated to these two.
